image_query: Elephanta Caves Trimurti Sadashiva sculpture Mumbai
tweets: Elephanta, Gharapuri island in Mumbai harbour — a Śiva temple hewn from basalt cliffs, generally dated to the 6th century CE under the Kalachuri kings. Its heart: a 20-foot Sadāśiva bust, three faces — Aghora fierce, Vāmadeva serene, Tatpuruṣa still. UNESCO, 1987.
